fixture: Fair arrival in three independent sequences, with prayer history reset before staging Thursday day 8, Friday day 9 and Thursday day 15 at 10:00. Wallet is set to 161 after filling the pouch with four loaves, and to 186 after buying work clothes, two loaves and dates for w06–w07. A clean loom-only reputation sequence funds the five outfits in advance, leaving the fair arrival wallet (198) after the purchases.
method: Native Godot viewport. Production GUI clicks buy and equip the items. The harness pauses passive clock ticks and stages player positions and camera direction. Street use opens the loom through the input action.
